therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of ischemia-reperfusion injury and oxidative stress
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: neonates undergoing congenital heart surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum decline in indexed cardiac output from 1 hour postoperative to lowest output within 24 hours postoperative

results.effect_size: NAC: 0.29 L/min/m² vs Placebo: 0.68 L/min/m² mean maximum decline in indexed cardiac output
biomarker_changes: Maximum serum creatinine over first 3 days: NAC 0.74 mg/dL vs Placebo 0.99 mg/dL
Total urine output over first 24 hours: NAC 176 mL vs Placebo 96 mL
safety_signals: Bleeding requiring surgical re-exploration: 1/11 in NAC group
Grade II bleeds on head ultrasound: 1/10 in placebo group
Patient placed on ECMO in operating room: 1/11 in NAC group

dose_info.dose: Loading dose 100 mg/kg IV; maintenance 10 mg/kg/hr IV
dose_info.schedule: Loading dose over 1 hr prior to surgery; maintenance infusion for 24 hrs starting after weaning from CPB

adverse_events.term: Grade II bleeds on head ultrasound
Patient placed on ECMO in operating room

context.duration: 24 hours postoperative (primary); 72 hours for secondary outcomes
